title: The Cat in the Straw
lines: Pam went to the barn to get straw for the hens.
She saw a small cat deep in the straw.
One paw was caught on a bit of rope.
Pam had to haul the straw away to see it.
She held a soft hand by the caught paw.
The cat hissed and held up a sharp claw.
Pam sat back on the straw to think.
Then she went in and got a bowl of milk.
She set it in the straw and sat still.
She did not speak, and she did not reach.
At last the cat came and licked up the milk.
Then Pam got the paw free with soft hands.
The rope fell off, and the cat was free.
It did not run away from her at all.
It sat by Pam and licked its paw clean.
Pam gave the small cat a name: Straw.
The small cat sleeps in the barn on the soft straw.

questions.ask: What was the paw caught on?
questions.listenFor: A bit of rope in the straw. Have them find the line.

questions.ask: What did Pam do after the cat hissed at her?
questions.listenFor: She got a bowl of milk, set it in the straw, and sat still until the cat came.

questions.ask: Do you think the cat trusts Pam now? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. The last line is the best clue.
